paragraphs: AMETEK, Inc. ("AMETEK" or the "Company") is incorporated in Delaware. Its predecessor was originally incorporated in Delaware in 1930 under the name American Machine and Metals, Inc. AMETEK is a leading global manufacturer of electronic instruments and electromechanical devices with operations in North America, Europe, Asia and South America. AMETEK maintains its principal executive offices at 1100 Cassatt Road, Berwyn, Pennsylvania, 19312. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: AME), the common stock of AMETEK is a component of the Standard and Poor's 500 and the Russell 1000 Indices.

AMETEK's products are marketed and sold worldwide through two operating groups: Electronic Instruments ("EIG") and Electromechanical ("EMG"). Electronic Instruments is a leader in the design and manufacture of advanced instruments for the process, power and industrial, and aerospace markets. Electromechanical is a differentiated supplier of precision motion control solutions, highly engineered medical components and devices, thermal management systems, specialty metals and electrical interconnects. Its end markets include aerospace and defense, medical, automation and other industrial markets.
Management believes AMETEK has significant competitive advantages that help strengthen and sustain its market positions. Those advantages include:

Strong Market Share. AMETEK maintains strong market share in a number of targeted niche markets through its ability to produce and deliver high-quality, differentiated products at competitive prices. EIG has strong market positions in niche segments of the process, power and industrial, and aerospace markets. EMG holds strong positions in niche segments of the aerospace and defense, automation and medical markets.

Technological and Development Capabilities. AMETEK believes it has certain technological advantages over its competitors that allow it to maintain its leading market positions. Historically, the Company has demonstrated an ability to develop innovative new products and solutions that support customer needs. AMETEK has consistently added to its investment in research, development and engineering, and improved its new product development efforts with the adoption of Design for Six Sigma and Value Analysis/Value Engineering methodologies along with artificial intelligence tools. These have improved the pace and quality of product innovation and resulted in the introduction of a steady stream of new products across all of AMETEK's businesses and aligned with attractive secular growth markets.

Efficient and Flexible Manufacturing Operations. Through its Operational Excellence initiatives, AMETEK has established a lean and flexible manufacturing platform for its businesses. In its effort to achieve best-cost manufacturing, AMETEK has operating facilities, as of December 31, 2025, in China, Czechia, Malaysia, Mexico, and Serbia. These facilities offer proximity to customers and provide opportunities for increasing international sales. Acquisitions also have allowed AMETEK to achieve operating synergies by consolidating operations, product lines and distribution channels, benefiting both of AMETEK's operating groups.

Experienced Management Team. Another component of AMETEK's success is the strength of its management team and that team's commitment to improving Company performance. AMETEK senior management has extensive industry experience and an average of approximately 24 years of AMETEK service. The management team is focused on delivering strong, consistent and profitable growth, growing

shareholder value, and creating a sustainable future for all stakeholders. Individual performance is tied to financial results through Company-established stock ownership guidelines and equity incentive programs.

AMETEK is committed to achieving earnings growth through the successful implementation of the AMETEK Growth Model. The goal of the Growth Model is high single digit annual percentage growth in sales and double digit annual percentage growth in earnings per share over the business cycle, strong cash flow generation, and a superior return on total capital. Other financial initiatives have been or may be undertaken, including public and private debt or equity issuance, bank debt refinancing, local financing in certain foreign countries and share repurchases.

AMETEK's Growth Model integrates the four growth strategies of Operational Excellence, Strategic Acquisitions, Global and Market Expansion, and New Product Development with a focus on cash generation and capital deployment.

Operational Excellence. Operational Excellence is AMETEK's cornerstone strategy for accelerating growth, improving profit margins and strengthening its competitive position across its businesses. Operational Excellence focuses on initiatives to drive increased organic sales growth, improvements in operating efficiencies and sustainable practices. It emphasizes team building and a participative management culture. AMETEK's Operational Excellence strategies include lean manufacturing, global sourcing, Design for Six Sigma, Value Engineering/Value Analysis, growth kaizens, digitalization and use of artificial intelligence technology. Each plays an important role in improving efficiency, enhancing the pace and quality of innovation and driving profitable sales growth. Operational Excellence initiatives have yielded lower operating and administrative costs, shortened manufacturing cycle times, resulted in higher cash flow from operations and increased customer satisfaction. They also have played a key role in achieving synergies with newly acquired companies.

Strategic Acquisitions. Acquisitions are a key to achieving the goals of the AMETEK Growth Model. Since the beginning of 2021 through December 31, 2025, AMETEK has completed 15 acquisitions with annualized sales totaling approximately $1.8 billion. AMETEK targets companies that offer a compelling strategic, technical and cultural fit. It seeks to acquire businesses in adjacent markets with complementary products and technologies. It also looks for businesses that provide attractive growth opportunities aligned with strong secular growth themes, often in new and emerging markets. AMETEK's management team has developed considerable skill in identifying, acquiring and integrating new businesses. As it has executed its acquisition strategy, AMETEK's mix of businesses has shifted toward those that are more highly differentiated and, therefore, offer better opportunities for growth and profitability.

Global & Market Expansion. AMETEK has experienced significant growth outside the United States, reflecting an expanding international customer base, investments in its global infrastructure and the attractive growth potential of its businesses in overseas markets. While Europe remains its largest overseas market, AMETEK has pursued growth opportunities worldwide, especially in key emerging markets. It has grown sales in Latin America, Middle East and Asia by driving its global and market expansion strategy and initiatives. AMETEK also has expanded its sales, service, and engineering capabilities globally. Recently acquired businesses have further added to AMETEK's international presence.

New Product Development. New products are essential to AMETEK's long-term growth. As a result, AMETEK has maintained a consistent investment in new product development and engineering. AMETEK's businesses help solve our customers' most complex challenges with differentiated technology solutions. In 2025, AMETEK added to its highly differentiated product portfolio with a range of new products across many of its businesses.

paragraphs: You should consider carefully the following risk factors and all other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and the documents we incorporate by reference in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Any of the following risks could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

A number of the industries in which we operate are cyclical in nature and therefore are affected by factors beyond our control. A downturn in the U.S. or global economy, and, in particular, in the aerospace and defense, oil and gas, process instrumentation or power markets could have an adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.

Our growth depends in part on the growth of the markets which we serve. Visibility into the future performance of certain of our markets is limited (particularly for markets into which we sell through distribution). Our quarterly sales and profits depend substantially on the volume and timing of orders received during the fiscal quarter, which are difficult to forecast. Any decline or lower than expected growth in our served markets could diminish demand for our products and services, which would adversely affect our financial statements. A number of our businesses operate in industries that may experience periodic, cyclical downturns. In addition, in certain of our

businesses, demand depends on customers' capital spending budgets, as well as government funding policies. Matters of public policy and government budget dynamics, as well as product and economic cycles, can affect the spending decisions of these customers. Demand for our products and services is also sensitive to changes in customer order patterns, which may be affected by announced price changes, changes in incentive programs, new product introductions and customer inventory levels. Any of these factors could adversely affect our growth and results of operations in any given period.

Our success is partly dependent upon properly executing and realizing cost savings or other benefits from our ongoing production and procurement initiatives. These initiatives are primarily designed to make the Company more efficient, which is necessary in the Company's highly competitive industries. These initiatives are often complex, and a failure to implement them properly may, in addition to not meeting projected cost savings or benefits, adversely affect our business and operations.

International sales for 2025 and 2024 represented 48.2% and 47.4% of our consolidated net sales, respectively. As a result of our growth strategy, we anticipate that the percentage of sales outside the United States will increase in the future. As of December 31, 2025, we have manufacturing operations in 22 countries outside the United States, with significant operations in Canada, China, France, Germany, Mexico, Serbia, Poland and the United Kingdom. A disruption of our ability to obtain a supply of goods from these countries or a change in the cost to purchase, manufacture, or distribute these products could have an adverse effect on our sales and operations. paragraphs: The Company benefits from its strategic initiatives under the AMETEK Growth Model's four key strategies: Operational Excellence, Strategic Acquisitions, Global & Market Expansion and New Products. In 2025, the Company posted record sales, operating income, net income, diluted earnings per share, orders, and backlog, as well as strong operating cash flow. Positive market trends, the Company's backlog, contributions from recent acquisitions, and benefits from the continued implementation of the AMETEK Growth Model had a positive impact on 2025 results.
•Net sales for 2025 were a record $7,401.1 million, an increase of $459.9 million or 6.6%, compared with net sales of $6,941.2 million in 2024.
•Net income for 2025 was a record $1,480.1 million, an increase of $104.0 million or 7.6%, compared with $1,376.1 million in 2024.
•Diluted earnings per share for 2025 were a record $6.40, an increase of $0.47 or 7.9%, compared with $5.93 per diluted share in 2024.

•Orders for 2025 were a record $7,579.4 million, an increase of $769.1 million or 11.3%, compared with $6,810.3 million in 2024. The Company's backlog of unfilled orders at December 31, 2025 was a record $3,581.5 million.
•Cash provided by operating activities totaled $1,801.8 million in 2025. Free cash flow (cash flow provided by operating activities less capital expenditures) was $1,671.6 million in 2025.
•During 2025, the Company spent $933.2 million in cash, net of cash acquired, to purchase two businesses:
•In January 2025, AMETEK acquired Kern Microtechnik ("Kern"), a leading manufacturer of high-precision machining and optical inspection solutions.
•In July 2025, AMETEK acquired FARO Technologies ("FARO"), a leading provider of 3D measurement and imaging solutions.
•EBITDA (earnings before interest, income taxes, depreciation, and amortization) was a record $2,296.9 million in 2025, compared with $2,151.7 million in 2024.

•In 2025, the Company repurchased approximately 2.3 million shares of its common stock for $443.0 million, compared with $212.0 million used for repurchases of approximately 1.2 million shares in 2024.

•The Company continued its emphasis on investment in research, development and engineering, spending $382.8 million in 2025. Approximately 27% of sales in 2025 were from products introduced in the past three years.

headings: 永續性與人力資本管理
paragraphs: AMETEK, Inc. ("AMETEK" 或 the "Company") 為德拉華州公司。其前身於1930年在德拉華州註冊成立，名為American Machine and Metals, Inc. AMETEK 是全球知名的電子儀器與電機機械裝置製造商，業務範圍遍及北美、歐洲、亞洲及南美洲。AMETEK 的主要營運總部位於賓夕法尼亞州伯倫（Berwyn）1100 Cassatt Road, 19312。AMETEK 股票於紐約證券交易所（代碼：AME）上市，其普通股為標準普爾500指數及Russell 1000指數的組成成分。
AMETEK 的產品透過兩個營運部門在全球市場進行行銷與銷售：電子儀器（"EIG"）與電機機械（"EMG"）。電子儀器在過程、電力與工業以及航空太空市場的先進儀器設計與製造領域為領導者。電機機械為精密運動控制解決方案、高度工程化醫療零組件與設備、熱管理系統、特殊金屬與電氣連接器的差異化供應商。其最終應用市場包括航空與防禦、醫療、自動化及其他工業市場。
管理階層認為 AMETEK 具備顯著的競爭優勢，有助於強化與維持其市場地位。這些優勢包括：
強大的市場佔有率。AMETEK 透過其生產與交付高品質、差異化產品的能力，在多個目標利基市場維持強大的市場佔有率。EIG 在過程、電力與工業以及航空太空市場的利基段落擁有強大的市場地位。EMG 在航空與防禦、自動化及醫療市場的利基段落擁有強大地位。

科技與開發能力。AMETEK 認為其擁有某些科技優勢，使其能維持其領先市場地位。歷史上，本公司已展現出開發創新新產品與解決方案的能力，以支持客戶需求。AMETEK 一直增加對研究、開發與工程的投資，並透過採用設計六西格瑪與價值分析/價值工程方法論以及人工智慧工具，提升新產品開發的成效。這些措施已提高產品創新速度與品質，並導致在 AMETEK 所有業務中持續推出新產品，並與具吸引力的長遠成長市場趨動方向一致。

高效且靈活的製造作業。透過其運營卓越計劃，AMETEK 已為其業務建立了一個精益且靈活的製造平台。為實現最佳成本製造，AMETEK 在 2025 年 12 月 31 日擁有中國、捷克、馬來西亞、墨西哥與塞爾維亞的製造設施。這些設施能提供與客戶的地理接近性，並提供增加國際銷售的機會。收購也使 AMETEK 能透過整合運營、產品線與銷售通路，實現運營協同效益，同時為 AMETEK 的運營羣體帶來好處。
經驗豐富的管理團隊。AMETEK 成功的另一個零組件是其管理團隊的強大與該團隊對提升本公司績效的承諾。AMETEK 高階管理團隊擁有廣泛的產業經驗，且平均服務年資約為 24 年。管理團隊專注於實現強勁、一致且獲利的成長，提升股東價值，並為所有利害關係人創造可持續的未來。個人表現透過本公司所設立的股票擁有指南與股權激勵計劃與財務結果掛鉤。
創造可持續的未來。AMETEK 的管理團隊專注於實現強勁、一致且獲利的成長，提升股東價值，並為所有利害關係人創造可持續的未來。個人表現透過本公司所設立的股票擁有指南與股權激勵計劃與財務結果掛鉤。
AMETEK 以成功落實 AMETEK Growth Model 來達成獲利成長的目標。Growth Model 的目標是在商業週期中實現銷售高單位數年增百分比成長與每股盈餘雙位數年增百分比成長，強勁的現金流產生，以及總資本的優越回報率。其他財務計畫已執行或可能執行，包括公開發行或私募發行債務或股權、銀行貸款再融資、特定外國國家的當地融資以及股票回購。
AMETEK 的 Growth Model 整合了 Operational Excellence、Strategic Acquisitions、Global and Market Expansion 與 New Product Development 四大成長策略，並著重於現金產生與資本配置。

Operational Excellence。Operational Excellence 是 AMETEK 加速成長、改善利潤率與強化其各業務競爭地位的基石策略。Operational Excellence 聚焦於推動有機銷售成長、提升營運效率與永續實踐的計畫。它強調團隊建設與參與式管理文化。AMETEK 的 Operational Excellence 策略包括精實製造、全球採購、Design for Six Sigma、Value Engineering/Value Analysis、成長 kaizens、數位化與人工智慧技術的應用。每項策略在提升效率、增強創新速度與品質以及推動獲利性銷售成長方面均扮演重要角色。Operational Excellence 計畫已降低營運與行政成本、縮短製造週期時間、提高營運現金流與提升客戶滿意度。這些計畫也對實現與新收購公司產生的協同效應發揮關鍵作用。

Strategic Acquisitions。收購是實現 AMETEK Growth Model 目標的關鍵。自 2021 年初至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，AMETEK 已完成 15 次收購，年化銷售總額約為 18 億美元。AMETEK 聚焦於提供具備強大戰略、技術與文化契合度的公司。它尋求收購鄰近市場的公司，這些公司擁有補充性的產品與技術。AMETEK 也尋找提供具吸引力成長機會的公司，這些機會與強勁的長期成長趨勢相符，常見於新興市場。AMETEK 的管理團隊已發展出相當程度的技能，用以識別、收購與整合新公司。隨著執行其收購策略，AMETEK 的業務組成已朝向更具差異化且因此提供更好成長與獲利機會的方向轉變。

Global & Market Expansion。AMETEK 在美國境外經歷顯著成長，反映國際客戶羣體的擴張、對全球基礎設施的投資以及其業務在海外市場的強勁成長潛力。雖然歐洲仍是其最大的海外市場，但 AMETEK 已在全球範圍內追求成長機會，特別是在關鍵新興市場。透過推動全球與市場擴張策略與計畫，AMETEK 已在拉丁美洲、中東與亞洲地區增加銷售。AMETEK 也已在全球擴展其銷售、服務與工程能力。最近收購的公司進一步增強了 AMETEK 的國際存在。
New Product Development。新產品對 AMETEK 的長期成長至關重要。因此，AMETEK 已持續投資於新產品開發與工程。AMETEK 的業務協助解決客戶最複雜的挑戰，提供差異化的技術解決方案。在 2025 年，AMETEK 透過其業務中多項領域的廣泛新產品，擴充了其高度差異化的產品組合。

paragraphs: 本公司因應 AMETEK 成長模式的四大關鍵策略：運營卓越、戰略收購、全球與市場擴張及新產品，獲得了戰略性優勢。2025 年，本公司創下銷售額、營運收入、淨收入、稀釋每股盈餘、訂單及待履行訂單的新高，同時營運現金流表現強勁。正面的市場趨勢、本公司待履行訂單、近期收購的貢獻，以及 AMETEK 成長模式持續落實的效益，對 2025 年的結果產生正面影響。
•2025 年的淨銷售額為歷史新高 74.011 億美元，較 2024 年的 69.412 億美元增加 4.599 億美元或 6.6%。
•2025 年的淨收入為歷史新高 14.801 億美元，較 2024 年的 13.761 億美元增加 1.04 億美元或 7.6%。
•2025 年的稀釋每股盈餘為歷史新高 6.40 美元，較 2024 年的 5.93 美元稀釋每股盈餘增加 0.47 美元或 7.9%。
•2025 年的訂單為歷史新高 75.794 億美元，較 2024 年的 68.103 億美元增加 7.691 億美元或 11.3%。本公司於 2025 年 12 月 31 日的待履行訂單為歷史新高 35.815 億美元。
•2025 年營運活動產生的現金為 18.018 億美元。自由現金流（營運活動產生的現金減去資本支出）為 16.716 億美元。
•2025 年，本公司以淨現金 9.332 億美元購入兩家企業：
•2025 年 1 月，AMETEK 收購 Kern Microtechnik（"Kern"），一家高精度機械加工及光學檢測解決方案的領導製造商。
•2025年，本公司稅前營業利益（EBITDA，即利息、所得稅、折舊及攤銷前盈餘）達2,296.9 百萬美元，較2024年的2,151.7 百萬美元創下歷史新高。
•於2025年，本公司購回約2.3百萬股普通股，總金額為443.0百萬美元，相較於2024年用於購回約1.2百萬股的212.0百萬美元。
•本公司持續強調對研究、開發與工程的投資，2025年支出為382.8 百萬美元。2025年銷售額中約有27%來自過去三年內推出的產品。

headings: 與我們營運相關的風險
若我們銷售產品與服務的市場出現衰退、成長未達預期、經驗到週期性波動，或總體經濟出現普遍性低迷，可能會對我們的業務造成不利影響。
我們可能無法妥善執行，或實現預期的成本節省或效益，來自我們的運營卓越計劃。
國際與國內的經濟、政治、法律、合規與營運因素可能對我們的國際銷售與營運造成負面影響。
我們的國際銷售與營運可能因遵守出口法規而受到不利影響。
我們的聲譽、營運能力與財務報表可能因任何員工、代理人或商業夥伴的不當行為而受到損害。
若我們無法聘請、培訓並留住足夠數量的具備技能的高階管理人員及其他員工，可能會影響我們成功競爭的能力。
若我們無法及時開發新產品，可能會對我們的業務與前景造成不利影響。
本公司之技術對本公司之成功至關重要，若無法保護此技術，可能使本公司處於競爭劣勢。
若供應鏈之零組件或原材料出現中斷、短缺或價格上漲，可能對本公司營運產生不利影響。
本公司受許多政府法規管制，這些法規可能造成負擔或產生重大成本。
本公司所處產業為高度競爭，可能對本公司營運結果或擴張業務之能力產生不利影響。
本公司之業務及財務表現可能因資訊科技系統之重大中斷或安全漏洞而受到不利影響。
與本公司併購相關之風險
本公司之成長策略包含策略性併購。本公司可能無法完成未來之併購，或成功整合近期及未來之併購。
本公司透過併購協議取得公司之賠償條款可能無法完全保護本公司，因此本公司可能面臨未預期之負債。
與我們財務狀況相關的風險
某些環境風險可能導致我們需承擔與危險或有毒物質清理相關的成本，這可能會對我們的財務狀況產生不利影響。
我們在業務過程中會面臨多種訴訟及其他法律與法規程序，這可能會對我們的財務報表產生不利影響。
我們的循環信貸協議及其他債務協議中所包含的限制條款，可能會限制我們增加額外負債的能力。
paragraphs: 您應謹慎考慮下列風險因素以及本年度報告表10-K所包含的所有其他資訊，以及我們在本年度報告表10-K中引用的文件。任何下列風險都可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果及現金流產生重大且不利的影響。
我們所從事的許多產業具有週期性，因此會受到超出我們控制範疇的因素影響。美國或全球經濟的衰退，特別是在航空與防禦、油氣、流程儀器或電力市場的衰退，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生不利影響。

我們的成長部分取決於我們所服務的市場的成長。對某些市場未來表現的可見度有限（特別是透過經銷商銷售的市場）。我們的季度銷售與獲利大幅取決於財務季度內收到的訂單數量與時間，而這些訂單數量與時間難以預測。我們所服務市場的任何衰退或低於預期的成長，都可能降低對我們產品與服務的需求，這將對我們的財務報表產生不利影響。我們的許多業務運作於可能經歷週期性衰退的產業中。此外，在我們的某些業務中，需求取決於客戶的資本支出預算以及政府資金政策。
公共政策與政府預算動態，以及產品與經濟週期，可能影響這些客戶的支出決策。我們產品與服務的需求也受到客戶訂單模式變動的影響，而這些訂單模式可能受到宣佈的價格變動、激勵計畫變動、新產品推出以及客戶存貨水準的影響。任何這些因素都可能在任何特定期間對我們的成長與營運結果產生不利影響。
我們的成功部分取決於正確執行並實現我們持續進行的生產與採購計畫的成本節省或其他效益。這些計畫主要是為了使本公司更有效率，這在本公司高度競爭的產業中是必要的。這些計畫通常相當複雜，若未能正確執行，除了未能達到預期的成本節省或效益外，還可能對我們的業務與營運產生不利影響。

2025年與2024年的國際銷售分別佔我們合併淨銷售額的48.2%與47.4%。由於我們的成長策略，我們預期未來銷售額中來自美國以外的比例將增加。截至2025年12月31日，我們在美國以外的22個國家設有製造業務，其中在加拿大、中國、法國、德國、墨西哥、塞爾維亞、波蘭與英國有顯著業務。我們若無法從這些國家取得產品供應，或取得這些產品的採購、製造或分銷成本發生變動，可能會對我們的銷售與營運產生不利影響。國際銷售與營運會受到國際環境運作常見風險的影響，包括：
